title: Single-line list items round-trip unchanged after save and reopen — client note
preconditions: You are on a client's Close page with access to Client Info › Notes. Guards against the WMD-1920 fix's list-normalization altering ordinary single-line lists.

steps.action: Open the Client Info modal → Notes tab and open a note in the editor.
Create a bulleted list with three single-line items, then create a numbered list with three single-line items (one line of text per item, no Shift+Enter).
steps.expected_result: Both lists render with one line per item and correct bullet/number markers.

steps.action: Wait for auto-save, then close and reopen the note.
steps.expected_result: Both lists render exactly as before: one line per item, correct markers and numbering, with no duplicated, dropped, merged, or extra blank lines.
